# Hive (hivenow.in)

> Hive is a hyperlocal fashion marketplace based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It connects customers with verified local boutiques, brands, and fashion designers across Kochi and Ernakulam, and delivers fashion — kurtis, dresses, shirts, jeans, sarees, footwear, and accessories — to doorsteps in approximately 90 minutes.

## Key Facts
- Operated by Beelyn LLP (LLPIN: ACS-4901), registered in Ernakulam, Kerala, India
- Alternate name: HiveNow
- Service area: Kochi / Ernakulam district (Kakkanad, Edappally, Panampilly Nagar, Vyttila, Aluva, MG Road, Kaloor, Fort Kochi)
- Delivery: Hyperlocal, approximately 90 minutes from local partner boutiques
- Categories: Kurtis, dresses, shirts, jeans, sarees, co-ord sets, footwear, accessories, women's ethnic wear, western wear, men's fashion
- Contact: +91 73560 19103 / support@hivenow.in

## What Hive Does
Hive aggregates live product inventory from independent fashion boutiques and brands across Kochi and Ernakulam. Shoppers can browse products, place orders, and receive fashion at their door in approximately 90 minutes. Boutique owners can list products and reach local customers through Hive's platform.

## Content Types
- Blog: Fashion guides, fabric advice, and styling tips tailored to Kerala's climate, written by the Hive editorial team
- Product listings: Live inventory from partner boutiques with real-time pricing and availability
- Location landing pages: Area-specific delivery information for Kochi and Ernakulam neighbourhoods
